brief: Scheduling and team-management app for restaurants: rotas in 3 clicks, shift swaps between staff, clock-in, payroll export. 2,400 restaurants use it across the UK and France. Target: restaurant and bar owners. Channel: Instagram Reels. CTA: first month free at fourmi.app.
angle: Product demo: believable mobile app screen, finger/cursor, a weekly rota filling itself, a shift-swap notification being approved.
